$comment: Schema and example for docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/compromises.json. Produced by autopilot at a milestone boundary to present the '完走後通知' (notify-after-completion) compromises in a categorized, actionable form. This file holds ONLY the local compromises that autopilot was allowed to make and continue past (§2.4 'notify-after-completion' categories). The 'immediate-stop' categories (acceptance_criteria_modified, destructive git, ADR violation) never reach this file because autopilot halts on them instead of recording-and-continuing.

$rules.when_written: Generated at milestone arrival, immediately before comprehension-report.md. One file per Sprint under sprint-logs/{SprintID}/.
$rules.trust_source: The verifier sub-agent's verification-report.json is the authoritative source for this file. When autopilot's self-reported compromises and the verifier's findings disagree, the verifier wins and the missed item is recorded with overlooked_by_autopilot: true. See references in autopilot/SKILL.md → Constraints and Forbidden Actions, and sprint/references/verifier-agent.md.
$rules.relationship_to_done_judgment: Distinct axis from the done-judgment guards (sprint-done-judgment.md). A guard failure moves a Story to needs_user_review; a compromise is a local concession autopilot made while still completing the Story. A single weakened assertion can appear in BOTH (as a guard-2/guard-3 fail AND as a test_assertion_weakened compromise) — that is expected, not double-counting.

type_semantics.test_skipped: it.skip / xtest / @pytest.mark.skip added, or expect(true).toBe(true) stub
type_semantics.test_assertion_weakened: toEqual → toBeTruthy, concrete value → any value, specific → loose matcher
type_semantics.type_safety_relaxed: change to any, abusive as casts
type_semantics.acceptance_criteria_modified: AC removed/loosened in ROADMAP.json — IMMEDIATE-STOP category; appears here only if surfaced retroactively, never as an autopilot-continued compromise

$rules.adr_ref: ADR-NNNN when the compromise relates to an ADR's decision, otherwise the string "none"
$rules.backward_compatibility: Optional, on-demand (§2.9). Absent file ⇒ display '妥協なし' (no compromises) or, for Sprints predating this mechanism, '過去 Sprint で記録対象外' (not recorded for this historical Sprint). Never back-generated for past Sprints.

compromises.rationale: OAuth provider の mock 複雑化を回避
compromises.recommended_action: OAuth mock を別 Story で整備して厳密化
